must.title: Security and Compliance
must.description: Ensure the process adheres to security and compliance standards.
must.metric: No security violations detected during process execution.
acceptance_criteria: Security checks are passed without violations.
Compliance with internal security policies is maintained.
Security incidents are logged and alerted.

must.title: System Reliability
must.description: The system should be reliable with minimal downtime.
acceptance_criteria: The system maintains uptime during the process.
Failures are logged and resolved promptly.

should.title: Performance Efficiency
should.description: The synthesis process should be efficient in terms of time and resource usage.
should.metric: Process completes within 5 minutes under normal load.
acceptance_criteria: The process completes within the defined time frame.
Resource usage does not exceed predefined limits.
Performance is consistent across multiple runs.
should.verification: Load test at expected peak; measure completion time and resource usage.

should.title: Usability
should.description: The system should be easy to use and understand.
should.metric: User satisfaction score of 4.5/5 or higher.
acceptance_criteria: Users can easily navigate and use the system.
Feedback mechanisms are in place for user input.

should.title: Scalability
should.description: The system should scale to handle increased load.
should.metric: System scales to handle 2x current load without degradation.
acceptance_criteria: The system handles increased load without performance loss.
